Evidence that none of the 8 are ours: every one carries an mtime at or before 2026-08-17 19:01:11, while this change's FIRST write (the impact manifest itself) is 2026-08-17 19:49:45 — a 48-minute gap, with the rest of our writes later still. Six of the eight also appear as already-modified in this session's own opening `git status` snapshot. configs/production/ACTIVE_VERSION's pending diff is v2_multi_2026_04 -> v2_htfcrt_2026_08, which predates this session (mtime 2026-08-15 23:00) and matches the value this change READ and left alone.
validator_outcome.action_taken: Deliberately NOT added to declared_files. Declaring a file this change did not modify would launder someone else's edit through this manifest and defeat the check's purpose. The honest record is BLOCKED with the evidence above; completion_status stays PARTIAL, never COMPLETE.
validator_outcome.what_would_unblock: A clean working tree, or a validator that diffs against a session-start baseline instead of the whole porcelain output. The latter is a real tooling gap worth raising separately; it is not fixed here (out of the authorized scope, and a silent validator change would weaken a governance gate).

Grid phase is MEASURED per candidate by re-aggregating the children, so a shifted TradingView grid is DISCOVERED, not merely rejected.
